title: Philips Hue Bridge HomeKit Accessory Protocol chacha20_decrypt Integer Underflow Remote Code… (CVE-2026-126979)
description: A remote code execution vulnerability exists in the Philips Hue Bridge HomeKit Accessory Protocol service due to an integer underflow in the chacha20_decrypt function. This flaw allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code without authentication by sending crafted pairing requests to the service listening on TCP port 8080.
